summary: A lost negotiation of self is like coming home with a package of Oreo Most Stuffed cookies because you..had..to know.. then as you spit out the first bite you recall how much you hate Double Stuffed Oreos #poetryport #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
A lost negotiation of self
is like coming home with
a package of Oreo Most Stuffed cookies
because
you..had..to know..
then as you spit out the first bite
you recall how much you hate
Double Stuffed Oreos
